notes.title: Patch Notes 10.65 - MASSIVE Content update - 3 New Heroes and more!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes: 06/07/2022 - v10.65[/b]


At last, a new patch is here! And it is our biggest patch EVER!

Thank you everyone for your patience as our team was working hard on creating some fresh new content for Arcanium! During those last months we focused heavily on adding more content to the game to diversify the Team-building possibilities and to increase our Artifacts pool.

We would like to apologize for the delays and for not being very active on the Steam forums. However, we’ve been active daily on our Discord server where we’ve been interacting with our community the most. We have been working closely with our amazing testers on Discord, to bring you the best content possible! After hundreds of hours of playtesting, discussing, iterating and number-crunching we think that the game is in the best spot it’s ever been. 60% of the existing content was rebalanced, fine-tuned and polished as a result.

For this massive content patch we have decided to batch 3 new heroes together (each with over 32 cards, 3 Heirloom Artifacts, etc...) and we’ve added a multitude of new Artifacts to the mix. Here’s a list of all the changes added to Arcanium in this patch:


[b]NEW CONTENT:[/b]

[b]New playable Heroes[/b]

3 New Heroes have joined the fight. You can unlock them via new challenges right now!

[list]
[*] Celeste, the Priestess of Illuna: New Healer focusing on direct heals to instantly keep her allies in good health and applying and manipulating Shock to increase your team Area damage.
[*] Bjorn, the Executioner: New Tank focusing on leveraging his own health as a resource, taunting, and dealing massive damage.
[*] Carrion, the Necromancer: New Mercenary focusing on very disposable minions and discard pile mechanics.
[/list]

[b]New Artifacts, Artifact balance pass and Artifact changes[/b]

48 New Artifacts have been added to the game which are discoverable in all 3 Provinces.
We rebalanced a lot of the old Artifacts and changed a handful that were seeing little to no use.


[b]Hero abilities changes[/b]

Angorn - Angorn had some identity issues and used to focus on Shielding. To capitalize on the “Druid” fantasy, we brought back Regeneration on some cards in his kit.


[b]Enemy abilities and Passives changes[/b]

Some enemies across all provinces received changes to their Passives and received the new Wound debuff on their abilities.


[b]STATUS EFFECTS CHANGES:[/b]

Some Status effects have been modified or changed to fit the ecosystem better:

[list]
[*] (QoL) Crowd Control has been removed as a keyword. Now all status effects will display if they are a "Major Buff", "Minor Buff", "Major Debuff", or "Minor Debuff". Cleanse removed Minor Debuffs, and Dispel removed Minor Buffs. Nothing can remove the Major Buffs or Debuffs. So it functions the same, just, clearer on the naming convention. 
[*] Wound (New) - Added to the game and it will reduce all incoming Healing by 50%.
[*] Sunder (Nerfed) - No longer reduces incoming healing and shields, to just reducing incoming Shields by 50%.
[*] Regeneration (New) - Regeneration is a buff that stacks on allies and Restores health at the start of the next turn by consuming all stacks until the target reaches full health. Doesn’t decay.
[*] Shock (Buffed) - Now also deals damage to the target you hit that has shock, in addition to dealing damage in an Area.
[*] Haste (Buffed) - No longer decays at the end of each turn, only on use.
[*] Ward (Buffed) - Now also increases incoming Healing by 50%.
[*] Blind (New) - Now prevents you from gaining Fury for 1 turn.
[*] Slow (Fixed) - Fixed to reduce all final damage calculations by 50%.
[/list]


[b]GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS AND QoL CHANGES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Changed the enemy passives that'd put cards in your hand that you'd simply never play to add a new keyword "Cursed". A Cursed card is unplayable, expends at the end of the turn, and triggers its effect every time you play another card while it's in your hand. 
[*] At the team select, when using the randomize button, the Ultimates will now also be randomized.
[*] Improved the status effect icons during battles to flash more accurately to the specific effect that was triggered.
[*] Increased the size of Card Upgrades that appear when you get to pick several upgrades at once.
[*] Improved Quest Tracker showing the right number of killed enemies when doing a "Kill X in Province" quests.
[*] Cataclysm which triggers at the end of the game now consumes Shard Battles too.
[*] Increased boss takeover of map nodes from 5 to 7 per step during cataclysm.
[*] Increased enemies damage and Health by 25% during Cataclysm.
[*] Leech now returns health to Minions
[*] Added Boss Anti-Major-Debuff passive to all Super Elites.
[*] Thick Skull mutation has been reworked to not allow Minor Debuffs. 
[*] Adjusted Loot and Shard battle rarity drops, to reduce frequency of Legendaries.
[*] Added a reroll cost increase at all shops, but reduced starting cost to 50 gold, incrementing by 50 gold per use, just like the Inn.
[*] Resetting Hero Fury to 0 when a hero or enemy dies.
[*] Ensuring that the first world quest is always from the starting chosen province.
[*] Increased Uzir Starting Gold bonus to 250 from 150.
[*] Adjusted Scorched Lands starting card bonus to show 3 upgraded cards.
[/list]


[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Blinding Flash fixed, it will now apply blind to any enemy with shock properly.
[*] Fixed exploration to ensure that you can't walk back and forth on vendors to increase the quest completion count.
[*] Fixed a bug where 2 or more damage-over-time damage applied to a target would count for 2 or more kills during Assault battles.
[*] “Corpse Explosion” and “Blade Parry” calculation fixed.
[*] Static Conduit X had the wrong (old) description. Fixed.
[*] “Purse Snatcher” fixed, it'll now look only at damage to the health instead of blocked amount as well.
[*] Lifestealing a dead enemy won't heal your Heroes.
[*] Cards dealing 0 damage will no longer trigger enemy passives that react to receiving damage.
[*] Fixed Sorgoth’s passive to not apply the effect if you dealt more than 8 damage.
[*] “Zora's Longsight” updated to work with all (non-self) cards including minions and ally based cards playable in all lanes.
[*] “Big Game Net” was fixed to only apply the bonus to the equipped hero.
[*] “Flask of Annihilation” was fixed to damage all enemies.
[*] Lifesteal is now enhanced by Spirit.
[*] Breached Barrels now return health from Leech (but not Lifesteal).
[*] Blossom (Angorn) and Faith (Celeste) ignore dead heroes.
[*] Fixed a bug letting you equip multiple heirlooms from the battle rewards screen.
[*] Fixed “Recycle” from adding duplicate cards into your discard pile.
[*] Fixed “Twisted staff” from adding duplicates to your discard pile.
[*] Fixed “Miracle Mack” event (Anador) that would add the threat but not duplicate the artifact of your choice.
[*] Fixed “Sacred Bastion” to always reduce Bolster cards regardless of if Leon is targeted or not.
[*] Updated these artifacts to now work with Breached Barrels: Assassins Mask, Infernal Lash, Juggernaut, Razor Shard, Spectral Cutlass, Sunshatter Blade, Vampiric Scepter, Vanquishers Pauldron, Virulent Blade, Wraiths Blade, Reptarian Hatchet, Skaros Sword.
[*] Fixed Echo cards to more properly recognize your hand size, and fill it properly if you had a full hand and played an echo card. It'll draw that echo card.
[*] Echo cards that can't be drawn due to other card drawing effects like haste or artifacts will no longer put the echoed card on the top of your draw pile.
[*] Ensuring all new "Major and Minor" buffs and debuffs remove themselves from a target when it dies.
[*] Fixed an issue where many of the + cards weren't properly showing their Spell FX.
[*] Updated some enemy passives to show a counter to keep track of the condition (i.e. Concealment, Dark Veil, Petrification, Reconstruct)
[*] Fixed Corrupted Battles to clear their effects if you quit during the battle.
[*] Fixed “Steel Cage” to return the minion to the original caster hand. In the event of a Potion-based minion, it'll go back to the hand of the hero in the lane where the minion was initially cast.
[*] Fixed all “Boots” Artifacts  that were triggering twice if you moved another Hero into the lane.
[*] Fixed “Kneel” to once again remove a random card like it used to.
[*] Fixed “Volatile Blood” mutation from reapplying every turn after turn 3.
[*] Fixed “Sunder” not applying to living targets.
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies killed would stay at 0 health, and continue to attack.
[/list]


[b]WHAT’S NEXT?[/b]

[b]3 New Heroes:[/b]

The next and final content update before full 1.0 launch is scheduled to be released later this summer. The last 3 Heroes will join the existing roster, to bring the number of playable heroes to 16(!!!). These Heroes will be:

[list]
[*] Drakkaw, the Warlock. Drakkaw manipulates the Void to inflict crippling damage-over-time effects to his foes, and take pleasure in watching them suffer. He’s a literal nightmare and a great addition to any self-sustaining team that needs slow ramping damage on their side.
[*] Maverick, the Gunslinger. Maverick is a Shadowslinger that wields two weapons. He is fragile, but packs a punch! His specialty is playing a ton of cards each turn, at low or no cost thanks to his Ammo mechanic.
[*] Thoram, the Blacksmith. Thoram is tanky and supports his teammates by flooding the board with defensive Minions, and by shuffling “Upgrades” in his allies’ decks.
[/list]

(More on those three in a lengthy upcoming post)

[b]Arena mode:[/b]

The new Arena mode is a blast, and coming along really well. We are in the polishing stages at this point, and should have a beta ready for testing in the months before full release. 
Arena mode differs from the original “Adventure” mode by being a fast-paced, snappy 10-Battle run against increasingly harder foes. In between each battle, you’ll be able to edit your loadout, heal your wounds and purchase perks at the new vendor type: the Quartermaster.
Arena mode will also feature 15 new Enemies, 3 new Bosses, a plethora of cool features and new Status effects & Events. We can’t wait for you guys to try it out and give us your feedback!

Until then, happy gaming!

-The Arcanium team

notes.title: UPCOMING PATCH PREVIEW & MORE NEWS !!!
notes.notes:
[b]ARCANIUM PATCH PREVIEW - 05/06/2022[/b]

Hello everyone! Today I would like to talk about what we’ve been tinkering for the past months at Supercombo. We have a lot to talk about!

We wanted to change things up this time, and release a Hero pack instead of releasing one Hero after another. As a small team, we found it more efficient to batch VFX, SFX, illustrations, card design, QA and bug fixing. We also added over 40 Artifacts, reworked a dozen that weren’t seeing a lot of love from the community, and made a flurry of balance tweaks to the Hero abilities and Neutral cards.
Without further ado, here are the next 3 Heroes coming out this month.


[b]NEW HERO! BJORN (Elemental / Void)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906473/1bbcb54168ed9d8c7d444ac681637c805591a99a.png[/img]

Bjorn is a Rhino Executioner and a hybrid Tank / Assassin. He relies on dishing out damage while sustaining himself through the Lifesteal mechanic. He’s also a reckless hero that deals damage to himself while decimating his foes. His Passive “Grudge” generates a unique resource called “Rage” whenever he takes damage from any source. He then can use to perform powerful attacks. Bjorn fits well in a team needing an off-tank, and can take on the role of full-tank whenever built properly. Here are some of his cards:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906473/7f1f5a0c401fa5c733864445838a788a636060fe.png[/img]


[b]NEW HERO! CARRION (Void / Nature)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906473/1c99b7a443f99b549fd3691fc7bc882acfa2d0e8.png[/img]

Carrion is a Hyena Necromancer and a Mercenary. Carrion is able to flood the board with cheap skeletal carcasses that grow in power the more they are played in a battle. Thanks to his ability to fetch cards from his Discard, he can then play his minions over and over again to take advantage of their boosted stats. He can sustain his teammates by applying Leech to his foes (Leech heals the attackers whenever they hit the target) and by soaking the incoming damage with his army of the dead. Here are some of his cards:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906473/46a8201012e764c546435a6479b07a092a7bda80.png[/img]


[b]NEW HERO! CELESTE (Light / Arcana)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906473/f4d65173fbc58ebbff95a78f3722d60732230f7a.png[/img]

Celeste the Priestess of Illuna is a hybrid Support / Mage. She excels at healing her teammates while packing a punch. She can apply Shock to her enemies and Blind them, or dish out some pretty impressive burst damage to her foes. Her Passive “Protection of Illuna” generate a unique resource called “Faith”, that she can stack whenever she plays cards on her enemies. Her stacks of “Faith” will consume and Shield the most injured ally at the start of each turn. Celeste will fit perfectly in a Multistrike-heavy team. Here are some of her cards:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906473/6c85472fdef9ea6f50855cad823573c59194e4a6.png[/img]


[b]NEW ARTIFACTS[/b]

We added 40+ Artifacts to all three Provinces and tweaked a few more. All Artifacts also have received a serious balance pass and now feel better than ever! Additionally, each of the 3 new Heroes will come with 3 unique Heirloom Artifacts.


[b]IN THE WORKS[/b]

Arena mode:

We can’t be more excited about this one … We have been working hard on the new Arena mode (coming later this summer) and it is looking amazing! 
The mode is a brutal and snappy experience that will last between 45min and 1h. It is an action-packed mode that has no exploration part, and where you will go on a series of increasingly more difficult Battles. 
Between Battles, you will have the ability to spend Gold at the Quartermaster and purchase Abilities, Artifacts and Minions, as well as a multitude of buffs and upgrades for your Heroes. 
After each Battle, a random difficulty modifier (or “Bane”) will be applied to your run, forcing you to adapt to the situation. 
The Arena mode has a finite number of stages that you’ll have to go through, before getting a chance to defeat the Boss and final encounter. Finally, whenever your Heroes fall in battle, they will accrue Arena-specific “Injuries” such as Twisted Ankle, Contusion, Broken Arm, etc. These Injuries will stick to your Heroes until removed at the Quartermaster at a Gold cost.
Lastly, the Arena will also receive new exclusive enemies, including 4 new Bosses and 15 new Enemies, which we are developing and testing as we speak!
We are absolutely stoked about the new mode and can’t wait for you to enjoy it as well!

Until then, happy gaming and speak soon!
-The Arcanium team

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1/18/22 - 10.46 - Bug fixes and performance improvements

It's Here!!! The Big Patch has arrived on the on the Live Branch!! 

We would like to thank you all for your patience while we reworked some of the mechanics that were received poorly, and apologize for the disturbance. Thanks to your feedback, we were able to revert some of the features from last patch, improved in a lot of areas and fixed a ton of bugs! We are dedicated to making Arcanium the best game it can be, and dedicated to listen to all of your feedback. 

We have also decided to push back Arcanium's full 1.0 launch in order to focus on fulfilling the roadmap we had initially talked about. The roadmap will be updated very soon to reflect the changes.

[b]Patch Notes: 11/5/2021 - v10.41[/b]

- We brought back the ability to swap heroes to different lanes by dragging them. Doing so costs 1AP and can be done at any time.

- We went back to having Melee cards (same lane targeting) and Ranged cards (same/adjacent lane targeting), and lost the concept of "baseline range" on every card.

- Opportunities to draw cards was increased. Each Hero will redraw 3 cards at the start of each turn.

- Individual Action Points (AP) are back and each Hero will regain 3 out of 5 AP at the start of each turn.

- The Essence Upgrade screen will now let you give a selected Hero a permanent AP for the rest of the Run. Once all Heroes are maxed out, you will instead have access to a powerful team-wide heal instead.

- We changed the "New Ability Card" tiles on the map, to give away a bundle of 3 random cards for a chosen Hero, as opposed to giving 1 card. You will get Ability cards faster, replace some starters and will be able to create a lot more interesting builds quicker into the Runs.

- We added a lot of "Retain" cards to the game to balance the fact that all cards now flush at the end of each turn. Retain cards stay in your hand whenever you pass your turn. This will allow us to have a layer of strategy we didn't have before, where Retain cards will be pound-for-pound weaker than their non-Retain counterparts, but will be more flexible and played whenever the timing is right.

- We added a ton more VFX including all new ultimates for each Hero.

- We updated a lot of card illustrations including all new Minions.

- We added new Battle music tracks for more variety.

- We added a lot of the cosmetic frames that will be available at 1.0. You can find out about them by consulting the Achievements from the main menu and checking out each achievement. More cosmetic frames will be added in the next weeks.

[b]What's next?[/b]

We want to keep working closely with our players and fine-tune the balance. A ton of new VFX, Illustrations and sounds/music is under way and will be added to the game in the next weeks as well. When the dust will have settled, we will be ready to start working on the next content milestones.

First, we'll be releasing Celeste, the Priestess and Carrion, the Necromancer. 

At the same time, we will start implementing a brand new mode: Arena mode. Arena mode will be a more condensed, quick and action-packed mode with zero map exploration. That's right, Arena will let you pick a party of 3 Heroes and battle increasingly difficulty enemies until you reach the very last encounter, or fail. Vendors and special events will be inserted between battles at random and propose new cards, Artifacts, healing or team-wide perks. All enemies from all Provinces will mix up, forming unique compositions and puzzles that will keep you on your toes.



In the meantime, enjoy the patch, happy gaming everyone!

-The Arcanium team

notes.title: New MASSIVE content patch coming soon for ARCANIUM!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906473/047277acd311998f841e935efb5866bb9e36a8c9.png[/img]

[b]PRE-PATCH NOTES:[/b]

Hey everyone,

A massive new patch for ARCANIUM is coming on Tuesday October 26th! 

It has been a while since any update was made to Arcanium, and we would like to sincerely apologize for the delays. And no, we didn't take any time off if that's what you are wondering. Quite the opposite actually :)

Here's an overview of what's coming (we will post a detailed patch notes with the release next week):

[b]OVERVIEW:[/b]
The game is now “Content complete” and everything that will be released in 1.0 is now included.

[b]PERFORMANCE:[/b]
One of our top priorities was to address the performance issues on PC. We took this very seriously and worked hard to make the game run as smoothly as possible on most machines. You should now be seeing drastic performance improvements.

[b]CORE PROGRESSION LOOP:[/b]
We’ve made a lot of changes to the meta progression loop to make the game more engaging in the long-term and less “grindy”. The “Stones” system was removed entirely and the Heroes & Cosmetic items are now unlockable via achievements only. Any fresh account will now start with 3 “Starting” heroes: Leon, Milady and Aurora.

[b]TUTORIAL (WIP):[/b]
We added a brand new interactive Tutorial for new players, that will have you travel through our starting island and learn the ropes of the game in a fun and engaging way. It is not completely polished but we figured you would want to see it anyway, and we would love to hear your feedback! The Tutorial can be skipped and replayed at any time you want.

[b]TRANSLATIONS (WIP):[/b]
We are in the process of adding over 15 new languages to Arcanium including Korean, simplified Chinese, Japanese, French, German, Spanish and much more! Chances are you language of choice is already implemented but if it is not the case, it will most likely be at full launch. These new languages are a WIP and still being worked on, but we wanted you to have a look and give us your feedback anyway.

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS:[/b]
We added a whole new structure to the game called Achievements. Achievements are responsible for unlocking future Heroes. For example, Shinzo will now join your roster of Heroes whenever you defeat Aranax, the Brood Queen (Anador’s Boss) for the first time. But Achievements will also be used to unlock the newly added Cosmetic items. For example, the Anador Adventurer frame will be unlocked after unlocking 100% of the Anador Province.
All Achievements can be inspected via a new section of the game available from the main menu. 

[b]COSMETIC ITEMS:[/b]
Cosmetic items are also new and unlocked via Achievements. They consist of different styles of portrait frames that you can apply to your Heroes in battle to show off your skills. Some Cosmetics are unique to a specific Hero i.e. Master Frames become available whenever a Hero hits Level 20, while other cosmetics can be assigned to any of your Heroes before a Run.

[b]HEROES:[/b]
10 Playable Heroes are now available to play. Leon, Milady, Aurora, Shinzo, Tara, Ragnarok, Mozebus, Lazaar, Misty and Angorn.

[b]NEW PROVINCE:[/b]
We added a third Province: The Scorched Lands. The area comes with a set of 9 new enemies, Events and Boss - Noctus, the Fallen Prince. The Scorched Lands is a treacherous area where few adventurers have set foot into. Demons, Warlocks, Wraiths and Ghouls await your arrival!

[b]AKHAN, THE CALAMITY:[/b]
If all the above wasn’t enough already, we added the Final encounter to each of your Runs. That’s right, defeating one of the Province Bosses is no longer the end of the journey. Once you have done so, Akhan himself will summon you to the Arcanium island for the last showdown. Only once Akhan is defeated, you’ll have successfully defeated the Run.
Once you arrive at the final area you will be able to heal, shop and manage your inventory one last time before the last Battle.
Akhan can take on one of five “forms”, at random. Each one of his forms has its own set of cards, passive abilities, and ultimate abilities, and represent a different challenge that you’ll have to adapt to. Akhan, being the gigantic monster that he is, takes a lot of space. This is why we are representing him as 3 of the enemies in Battle. His body will take over the center lane, and his two arms and hands will take the left and right portraits. Lastly, each of Akhan’s forms is represented by a different skin color variation.
-Akhan, the Deceiver (Arcana) is geared towards controlling the Battle by disrupting your hands and card draw.
-Akhan, the Ascended (Light) is geared towards sustaining himself with strong heals and debuffing your Heroes with Blinds.
-Akhan, the Evolved (Nature) is geared towards using Poisons and Cleave attacks.
-Akhan, the Destroyer (Elemental) is geared towards making your Heroes Vulnerable and dishing huge amounts of single-target damage.
-Akhan, the Devourer (Void) is geared towards using Hex and weakening your Heroes.

[b]GAME DIFFICULTIES:[/b]
We have simplified the read and how the Game difficulties work. We went back to a more classic “Diablo” style with 7 difficulty settings to unlock. Normal mode is the only mode unlocked by default. By defeating Normal you will unlock Hard, then Expert, Challenger, Heroic, Mythic, Nightmare and finally Apex. Each mode will pile on more and more modifiers to your runs. The higher the difficulty, the more XP you will gain with each run.

[b]ARTIFACTS:[/b]
The game has 105 reworked Artifacts. Each Province received its own set of Artifacts and we removed the concept of Neutral Artifacts, meaning that no Artifact is shared between multiple Provinces. Part of being a good Arcanium player is knowing what Province to visit based on your team composition and overall strategy, since only a specific set of Artifacts will drop in each Province.

[b]HEIRLOOM ARTIFACTS:[/b]
Heirlooms are the most powerful Artifact in the game (Red rarity gem). They received some of the biggest changes too. You will no longer start Runs with Heirlooms assigned to your Heroes. Instead, Heirlooms will now drop from Super Elite encounters, and be equipped on a dedicated Artifact slot for each Hero. Each Hero has now 3 Heirlooms that they can find. Each Heirloom is tailored and enhances a specific playstyle for the Hero it belongs to, and only that Hero can equip it.

[b]ULTIMATE ABILITIES:[/b]
Heroes now have 3 Ultimate abilities they can swap out and equip before each Run. One Ultimate is unlocked by default while the other two will need to be unlocked via Leveling the Hero. Ultimates drastically change how the hero is played.

[b]HERO ABILITIES:[/b]
Each hero now has access to 24 personal Ability cards consisting of:
-3 Starter abilities (Grey Rarity)
-3 Ultimate abilities
-6 Common abilities
-5 Rare abilities
-4 Epic abilities
-3 Legendary abilities
Some of these cards are unlocked by default at Hero Level 1 while the rest will be unlocked by leveling the Hero with the XP gained during the runs.

[b]HERO PASSIVES:[/b]
Each Hero received a Passive ability that is unlocked by default and can not be changed. It represents the Hero’s playstyle and DNA, and affects how that Hero is played.

[b]NEUTRAL ABILITIES:[/b]
Neutral Abilities are back, and you will have access to 136 of them. Each Hero will be able to equip any Neutral ability as long as they belong to one of their two colors. For example, Leon is Light and Arcana (Yellow and Blue) so he’ll be able to make use of any Blue and Yellow Neutral ability found during the Run. Neutral abilities can be swapped between Heroes as long as their colors match. This allowed us to address some of the biggest core issues: the cards felt compartmented and the replayability suffered from it in return. The game lacked synergies, but this change alone boosted the replay factor, fun, and synergy significantly.
A portion of the Neutral abilities are unlocked by default, and the rest will be unlocked simply by leveling up your account (Mastery level) over time.

Now, for the significant changes of all:

[b]STARTING BLESSINGS:[/b]
Each Run will now start with a Province Blessing to choose from:
-Starting a Run in Anador will grant your team the Anador Blessing, increasing your party’s maximum HP for the rest of the Run.
-Starting a Run in Uzir will grant your team the Uzir Blessing, increasing your party’s starting Gold.
-Starting a Run in the Scorched Lands will grant your team the Scorched Lands Blessing, giving you access to a free Common Ability card.

[b]WORLD QUESTS:[/b]
Each Run will also start by proposing three World Quests at Random. You may mulligan each quest once, after which you will have to accept your fate. World Quests are added to a brand new Quest Log accessible from the in-game menu at any time.
World Quests are side-objectives that will challenge you and send you traveling to the four corners of the continent of Arzu. The Quests vary in difficulty and you will decide which ones to work towards. Each World Quest, once finished, will grant some incredible loot!

[b]EXPLORATION:[/b]
Some of the biggest changes and improvements went into the Exploration. You will have to experience the changes for yourselves but here’s a top-level list of changes:
-We completely revisited the system and how players interact with the map. Before the patch, you could see your “location” on the map and would be restricted by distance which always felt very underwhelming at times. You will now be able to push the exploration to extend your reach, and click on any available tile to teleport to it. This new system is more casual, fun and engaging and allows you to cover a lot more ground on each Run.
-The Province Bosses are not visible from the start, but now appear once you enter the “Cataclysm” phase. You enter “Cataclysm” by simply exploring and reaching a full Threat bar of 30 Threat points.
-Each time you visit a new tile in Cataclysm, 5 random tiles will turn into a Boss Battle. Soon enough, the map will be covered of them and you will have no choice but to engage the Province’s Boss.
Battle nodes block all surrounding tiles. Whenever you uncover a battle node, a big red “X” will appear over all its surrounding tiles, rendering them unclickable. You will have to defeat the battle tile in order to free the adjacent tiles.
-Shard battles are now optional, but are brutal Battles that will offer a guaranteed Heirloom Artifact as a Reward.

[b]COMBAT:[/b]
-Combat has been simplified a lot while retaining most of the DNA that makes Arcanium unique.
Heroes no longer can swap lanes by default. You now need Ability cards with the Dash and Teleport keywords to do so. A lot of new players never knew that you could swap Heroes as a part of the core gameplay, and we wanted to reduce the amount of hidden interactions players had with the game at any given time.
-To balance out the Swap nerf, we made all Abilities able to reach any adjacent lane by default. You won’t have to reposition your Heroes in order to be efficient any longer. That said, we also introduced new range keywords like Melee and Ranged written on a few cards. Melee cards can only be cast in their own lane, while Ranged cards can only be cast in adjacent lanes.
All unused cards are discarded at the end of each turn, and each Hero redraws 2 cards per turn by default. We wanted each turn to feel like a puzzle, and didn’t want previous turns to affect the outcome of a battle. We also wanted to eliminate any “irrelevant cards” overflow that some players used to experience.
-AP is now team-wide again. We decided to simplify the mechanic and go back to a more traditional style of resource. Your runs will start with 5AP shared by the whole team. Abilities from any of your Heroes will be paid for with the team’s AP, but will contribute to generating Fury only for that specific hero, like it used to.


[b]CHANGE TO CARD RARITIES AND POWER LEVELS:[/b]
We kept the rarities as they were in the previous patch (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary) but completely revisited what they mean, and created a new system that sets Arcanium apart from other games in the genre:

-We kept the Essence but simplified how it affects you. Whenever you defeat a Battle, your Party will automatically receive Essence (1 on normal Battles, 2 on Elites and 3 on Super Elites). Whenever you reach 5 Essence, your Party will simply receive an extra AP that will be added to your total team AP. 5, then 6, 7,8,9 to a maximum of 10AP towards the end of the Run.
-All card rarities are now based on the same power level i.e. a Common 1AP card deals 6 damage to an enemy, and a Legendary also deals 6 damage to an enemy. The fundamental difference is that the rarer a card is, the more expensive it gets. As a matter of fact, Commons usually have a cost of 1AP on average, while Rares cards cost 2AP, Epics cost 3AP and Legendaries cost 4AP.
-This change, coupled with the growing AP pool available to your heroes over the course of the Run, is what creates the crescendo and power spike. Battles will slowly become longer, more explosive and intricate as time goes by.
-More importantly, this change makes 100% of the cards you will find relevant until the end game (I often find myself using Commons in my final decks) and further extends the -already big- pool of available cards to equip, and further increases the synergy and build paths on all Heroes.
-Loading a deck with too many 1AP cards will most likely end up with your Hero “gassing out” since you are limited to 2 cards per hand on each turn and might have left-over AP at the end of your turn. But cheap cards are more flexible and versatile than the 3 or 4Ap counterparts.
-Loading a deck with too many 3-4AP cards will give you all the firepower you need but will often result in an un-flexible turn that can fall apart depending on RNG, your positioning etc...


That’s it for now! Thank you so much for reading our update, we hope that it all makes sense to you. Please do not hesitate to leave a comment on the Steam board and we will respond as fast as we can!

Until then, see you next week and happy gaming!

-The Arcanium team-

[b]Patch Notes: 5/17/2021 - v10.21[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]

[i]New playable Hero [/i]
- Misty has joined the Battle for Arzu! She is a fierce, fast and furious Monk and the newest new Assassin specializing in Multistrikes and Shock. She can deliver a barrage of blows and fry the enemy forces to a crisp! Her unique mechanic is called "Chi", that she can spend in various ways to empower her abilities. Up to 5 Chi can be stored on herself and Chi doesn't naturally decay on it's own.

[i]Exploration Updates[/i]
We have been very happy with the latest changes but listened to a lot of your feedback, and decided to tweak the exploration a bit. Our main focus was to fix the issue where it was free to roam around used tiles for free and virtually 'teleport' around the map without any time passing by or any notion of 'distance'. The experience is now a lot more engaging and takes planning, and the laws of physics will now apply to your party. Here is what we changed:

- We've increased the total steps to 90, and added a step cost to used nodes. We're also renaming "Steps" to "Threat" considering some other changes, so 90 Threat until the Boss fights you! Check the node costs on the Tooltip popup when hovering over them.
- Shops have been reworked so now you'll be saving shopkeepers out in the wild, who will give you a small reward for finding them. They will then be collected and added to the new Capital tile, where you can buy things from them.
- We added a new Teleport Scroll found on the left under your Hero Mini portraits. This charges up whenever you defeat a Shard Battle or when new Shards drop every 30 Threat. Use this to teleport to the various province capitals to buy cards or use the Inn to heal.
- The Day/Night got a little tweak. Daytime will allow you to see 2 tiles away now, to gather intel on the surrounding area, and at night you're visibility goes down to just 1 tile away. The Day count is no longer tied to anything specific, just there to reveal how long you've been in this run.
- Loot Caches rarity is once again picked when you actually step onto that node, instead of when it's discovered. This plays better with the exploration changes.
- The Inn is available at the Capital right away. You can Heal your party and Upgrade cards for a cost here.
- Click on the Capital at any time to Browse the currently unlocked shops in viewing mode.

[b]Other Updates[/b]

- The Apex Difficulties have been revisited and intensified with a couple of real spicy effects.
- Enemies have received a much needed rebalancing in addition to about 30% higher Health across the board. They now incorporate some new mechanics and will provide a more ways to leverage one another's abilities to hurt your Heroes.
- New Fixate mechanic! Fixate will always target whichever of your Heroes has the lowest current Health.
- New Slow mechanic! A new 1 turn CC (Crowd Control) status effect that reduces the AP and Cards you draw at the start of each turn by 1.
- Easy Elite enemies now gain access to passives. Keep an eye on those early elite fights, they've gotten a whole lot harder!
- The Campsite Upgrades have been reduced to 1 chosen card, or 2 random cards.
- The Oracle has also gotten the same Campsite setup along with the Transmute options.
- We had a pretty crazy issue with Power% and damage scaling to incredible heights from certain abilities that multiplied damage by something due to some internal calculation oddities and orders of things. This also led to a lot of cards showing an incorrect value of damage which led to a lot of confusion when dragging the card and seeing a very different (usually way bigger) number. These cards and mechanics have been fixed so what you see is what you get!
- Potions (Items) now show a damage preview.
- New Execute mechanic, that'll instantly kill any non-boss enemy if they are at or below 25% of their max health.
- When you Stun an enemy, they will now only stay Stunned for the turn where you play the ability.
- Added an option to show the enemy casting cards in the options menu.
- If you're playing a Single Target card onto the enemy side of the board, and there is no minion there, the targeting location will be hidden to avoid accidental drags to that slot.
- Added a Randomize team button in the hero selection window.
- Some heroes cards have been through a rebalancing act as well.
- Minions have been buffed with a lot of them gaining Pulse effects. Pulse occurs at the beginning of the turn AND instantly upon being played.
- Gold earnings have been also increased overall.
- Discarding cards will only cost 1 Fury regardless of the card's cost.
- Mimiko's Phaseshifter now makes all swapping and Dash cards teleport.
- Volatile Blood Mutation hits for 50% of the remaining enemy health instead of 100%.
- Void Wings changed to only triggering on Direct Damage instead of on hit. It also will ensure the enemy recasts the same card they were casting previously.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed issue with Enchants all showing and boosted values if you reapplied them while having other enchants on the same target.
- Fixed an issue with Gladiator Trident simply doing nothing.
- Fixed Oblivion Staff causing a crash.
- Fixed Camp showing 0.5% healed, now 50%.
- Fixed issue of using Retire on an enemy minion you captured with the Steel Cage, so you can play that minion from your hand now.
- Fixed swapping heroes pre-battle to set your positions costing AP sometimes.
- Fixed Cloak of Dusk from proccing while setting Hero Positions.
- Fixed some weird Apex resetting bugs that made Essence costs go up to 11 or higher, and campsites from damaging you instead of healing you after multiple runs.
- Quests will no longer repeat unless we run out of new ones to show.
- Fixed the refresh when buying cards using Stones before a run.
- Fixed being able to assign the same legendary and legendary+ ability to the same hero.
- Fixed a bug where after several stuns or other card play interruption, enemies would run out of cards to play.
- Apprentice robes no longer creates 0 stack status effects.
- Lost medallion given a little delay for the hand size update to register.
- Purifying Potion fixed to work better when removing stun and letting you use your cards.
- Preventing a shard you're about to step on from changing at step 10 or 20 or 30.
- Fixed Dragonheart to actually add Block correctly to the minions and they taunt when summoned.
- Tons of other smaller various fixes, typo fixes, and other things.
- Updating a lot of the Sounds FX, and fixing some super loud random fx whenever a battle begins.
- The Breach Shard can now be Vulnerable'd and Shocked.
- Fixed breach shard from retaining it's previous enemy resistance.
- Changed the Target Frame Rate for the game to 60fps to reduce the strain on video cards.
- Fixed Touche from just doing nothing.
- Fixed bug where drawing Detonate using Deep Calm would reset the cost of Detonate to 5.

[b]What's coming next?[/b]

Mozebus, the Ancient Arcanist is being prepped for next patch (ETA end of May). He is a Arcana/Void (Blue/Purple) Mage Hero that specializes in deck and enemy manipulation, and has the slowest playstyle of all the Heroes (What did you expect from a 600 years old Tortoise?) but hits like a ton of bricks!

Some well-needed Hero refresh will be applied to Leon and Ragnarok in an upcoming patch

We Also started looking into Localization (German, French, Spanish, etc) but more on that later.

Enjoy the patch everyone!

-The Arcanium team

notes.title: Patch V0.10.11: new! UZIR Province + MASSIVE Content update
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes: 4/12/2021 - v0.10.11[/b]


Hey everyone, we are very excited to release our massive content update for Arcanium: Rise of Akhan.
Here’s a detailed overview of all of the changes and additions available now in the new build.

[b]- New Province: Uzir, the Golden Plains[/b]
Uzir is a desert-themed Province with affinities for Elemental (Red), Light (Yellow) and Void (Purple). It will come with a brand new set of Enemies, Super Elites, Boss, Events, over 40x new Artifacts and much much more!

[b]- Exploration revamp: [/b]
The map Exploration has been completely pruned to truly feel like a new open-world experience. We simplified the rules and removed a lot of confusing mechanics that weren't contributing enough to the overall experience. More importantly, we removed the concept of Chapters from the game and the scale of map has been extended to a whole continent, with all the provinces connected by land. You will be in total control of your journey, picking up side-quests and exploring at your own pace. The Corruption mechanic is now replaced by a simpler “steps” system. A run will last 30 steps after what the final Boss will automatically engage your team in battle. Shards will rain down from the sky throughout the run, dropping optional challenging Super-Elite battles on the map that will reward you with incredible loot. The RNG from corrupted tiles appearing out of nowhere is gone as well. The exploration will be all about distance management, assessing risk vs reward and encouraging you to step out of your comfort zone.

[b]- New map and map controls:[/b]
The map’s 3d model has been recreated to show all the available provinces in one continent. The camera can be panned by using the WASD keys, or right-clicking (and even mouse wheel clicking) and dragging the cursor on the map.

[b]- XP gains update:[/b]
Every XP made on a province’s soil will contribute to that Province’s progression. The XP will be distributed accordingly and shown on the ‘End of run details’ screen.

[b]- New tile types:[/b]
With one single larger map, we really felt like the node types were very limited (battles, towns, events, loot caches and campsites) and were making the runs rather redundant. So we decided to add 2 to 3 times more tile types to break down the exploration. Towns are gone and were broken down into individual Forge, Alchemist & Trainer tiles. Oracle tiles will now allow you to Transmute your cards in random ones of higher rarity. The Capital is replaced by a portal in each Province, allowing you to fast-travel to any other portal on the continent.


[b]- New resource: Essence[/b]
Essence is the latest addition to the game. It is gained specifically by battling enemies and occasionally found via Events. Normal battles won give 1x Essence, Elites 2x Essences and Super Elites 3x Essences. Upon reaching 5 Essences, a pop-up will show you 4 Augments to choose from, that will enhance your heroes in various ways (Give access to the Ult+, added HP, added Power or extra AP). Essences are a way for your Heroes to scale harder along the journey and for the run to ramp up in difficulty faster, rewarding risk takers and making Super Elite battles very attractive for that reason.

[b]- New battle tiles types:[/b]
By splitting battles in three battle types visible from the map, we wanted to create varied ways to approach the combat during a run:

Assault Battles: This is the new name for the current battles on the live version of the game. The objective is to destroy 3 enemies to win

Breach Battles: New battle type that will task you to destroy an enemy to reveal a Shard of Umbra with its own HP. Once revealed, the Shard will stay active for a turn, then disappear to let a new enemy spawn in its place. The objective is to bring the Shard’s HP to 0 to win.

Defense Battles: New battle type that will require you to last a few turns and defend yourself, in order to win.

Each battle type will favor certain team comps, and will really encourage players to edit their decks beforehand. For example, Defense battles favor defensive teams that can sustain damage, but bursty teams will have an ok time as long as they can burst down enemies to prevent them from casting. While Breach types will favor teams that can burst down the Shard the fastest.

[b]- Shrines revamp:[/b]
Shrines will now be giving team-wide Blessings that will last for the entire run. 36x swingy Blessings with all kinds of crazy effects have been added to spice-up you runs. Shrine colors will be pre-determined from the map and each Shrine will be aligned with one color only. Each Province will naturally receive 3x Shrines (one of each color)

- New Game Difficulty: Apex mode
You will be able to unlock Apex mode by defeating the game once in Normal difficulty, and will have access to dozens of modifiers, or “Banes”, which will make your runs increasingly more challenging. Each time a run is defeated at your maximum Apex level, you will permanently increase it by 1 until you reach Apex 12 which is currently the maximum. Later this year, a mode called “Custom Apex” will allow you to customize which banes you wish to apply to you runs yourself.


[b]- Simplified UI:[/b]
We pruned the UI and worked on clarity. The game is a lot easier to look at for beginners or streams viewers.

[b]- Combat and Hero kits polish:[/b]
We simplified some rules and mechanics, and removed the Combo mechanic that felt a bit tacked-on and wasn’t generally well received by the community. Instead, we reworked some abilities to make sure that every Hero kit feels exhilarating, synergistic and that every card feels unique and works towards clearer archetypes.

[b]- Battle Targeting update:[/b]
You can now target Minions and Heroes individually. The change makes things easier for the whole mercenary class, since the enemy will always ignore your minions unless they have “Block” in which case they will be forced to attack them. To make the rule consistent, your Heroes will now be able to target the back row enemies and ignore Minions as well.

[b]- Heroes Rework:[/b]
Aurora received a big update to capitalize more on her identity. As a Fire Mage, she often felt more like a direct damage dealer and not like the reckless, pyromaniac that she is. Her kit was changed to focus more on burning everything that moves, including herself and her allies. She is also able to utilize the Burn stacks on herself to empower her attacks and even turn them against the enemy. She keeps her glass cannon identity, and is capable of dishing out massive numbers by destroying herself in the process. She will be best paired with a support to keep her alive as a result.

Milady is undergoing some more changes and unfortunately won’t be available for a few days after the patch launches.

All other Heroes got some of their ability cards rework if they used any mechanic related to the Combo mechanic, which was removed.

[b]- Final Bosses Rework:[/b]
Aranax and Ra’Khzar received some core changes to make their battles more engaging and challenging. Each boss now has 3 new Passives that rotate at the start of each turn, as well as resistances to 3 different colors that will also rotate each turn. Your Heroes will have to adapt to find the best way to deal with those on a turn by turn basis.

[b]- Performance Optimization:[/b]
We managed to get twice the FPS on both map and battles. You should see a drastic difference especially on slower and older machines.


[b]Other updates:[/b]
-Access to the Ult+ via having a full deck of 12 cards, was replaced by an extra card draw.
-Enemies no longer drop Gold in battle. Instead, for simplification sake, you will be rewarded by a new Gold card on the Rewards screen.
-Status effects are capped at 10 stacks for buffs and debuffs, at any given time. They now decay at 1 per turn.
-The Fury meter is gone and broken down into 3x individual Fury bars on each Hero. The coat of Ultimate abilities was reduced to accommodate the new change. As soon as your Ultimate bar is full, the Hero will be able to receive its Ult on command, whenever the time is right.
-A good number of Artifacts have received an update and new mechanics following the other changes.
-Filters were added to the Collection
-Economy was revisited and prices at the various shops changed


[b]Coming soon:[/b]
Milady’s rework should be out shortly after this patch's initial launch.
Mozebus, the ancient Arcanist will be coming by the end of April, introducing a new mage to the game.
Later in May, Arena mode will be launched, introducing a new way to play Arcanium

We hope that you will enjoy playing the game as much as we do, and as usual please don’t hesitate to send us your bug reports in-game, or by joining our amazing community on Discord at discord.gg/Arcanium

Happy gaming!
[i]-The Arcanium team[/i]

[b]Patch Notes: 2/19/2021 - v0.9.95[/b]

[b]New Hero - Tara:[/b]
- Tara, the first Marksman Hero of Arcanium, has joined the battle against Akhan!
- 2 of her Heirlooms are unlockable
- NEW set of 32 Abilities

[i]Enemies:[/i]
- Enemies Overall Health was decreased significantly throughout the run. Additionally, their Health will slowly increase throughout the run at 1health per corruption on your meter (so, going from 1 to 40 extra HP by the end of act 4). The battles are now more frantic and are a lot shorter, especially in act 1. This allowed us to shave off a good 30-45min of playtime to each run and allows players to cruise through act 1 faster than act 3 or 4.
- Wrath of Umbra (WoU): Enemies now gain +20% Power per stack of Wrath of Umbra. The mechanic has been reworked, and enemies will now gain 1 stack of WoU at the start at every turn as long as they are alive. All stacks of WoU are lost upon getting destroyed. Enemies will no longer respawn with a stack of WoU.
- This change was implemented to make the battles evolve over time and get more challenging as turns go by. This adds a sense of directionality and urgency and will force players to treat all enemies equally, starting by targeting the enemies with the most stacks to make sure their damage doesn't get out of hand. It was too easy to ignore enemies on the battlefield and focus target a specific enemy of lesser difficulty, over and over again. Not anymore! Passive/healing teams had to much of an easy time healing Heroes past their starting health, and often were ending battles with more health than they started the battle with. We hope that it will make the game more engaging whether you are using a steamrolling comp or a control/defensive comp.

[i]Changes:[/i]
- Heroes are now All Unlocked Right Away! Stones will be used (in a future patch) to speed up hero leveling, and purchase cosmetics and other goodies!
- Shard Battles have swarms of enemies hanging around. Now you will have to face a Hoard of enemies before the Super Elite emerges. There will always be 3 Enemies to take down first. If you approach the Shard before you're Corruption bar is filled, you will have to fight 1 extra enemy for each unused corruption on the meter.
- Updated a ton of Artifacts and abilities that were a bit too brokenly good or a bit lacking.
- Promote no longer kills your Minions, but just boosts them for the rest of that Turn.
- Stealth will now reduce the damage you take by 50% from any enemy not in your Lane.
- Transmute at the Oracle now upgrades your card to the next higher rarity too!
- Added 1 Starting Heirloom to all Heroes! Gain +8 Max Health, available on everyone, RIGHT NOW!
- Reworked the Boons from the Shrines to use % based Power and Resistances per color.
- Added some new cards to the Shrines, including + Combo Point bonuses for card colors.
- XP gains has been doubled throughout the game exclusively for early access. We understand that it is crucial for players during beta to unlock features as fast as possible in order to test things out.
- Added 1 Outpost and 1 Trader to the map at Run Start.
- Save game now also saves Use Tokens at Shrines.
- Enemies rotate and spawn a new enemy type when the revive now.
- Added Super Elite portraits up in the menu bar, so you can always prepare for the battle you're soon to encounter.
- Elite fights are back to killing 3 enemies, but they have more HP.

notes.title: Patch V0.9.93: RAGNAROK is out !
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: 1/29/2021
V.0.993


[b]NEW HERO: RAGNAROK[/b]

We’ve made some changes to the Battle and Exploration of ARCANIUM in order to make the game more engaging. These changes also addressed a lot of the core issues with the game, and make the experience a lot more balanced and enjoyable on all levels. We hope that we all enjoy the new version.


Ragnarok is OUT now! Here are some feature highlights:

Battle Hardened war commander and a Mercenary Class Hero.
Unlockable with 100 Anador Stones.
Specializes in playing Minion cards and boosting them in order to crush his foes.
Comes with a brand new set of 32x Ability cards and 2x Heirloom Artifact cards.
New Keyword: Promote. Promote will be found on Minions. Each time a Promote Minion is played on an already existing Minion on the board, it will absorb its Attack value to turn him into an even deadlier Minion! Doing so unfortunately will automatically apply “Exhaust” to the Minion and destroy it at the start of the next turn

[b]NEW ARTIFACTS:[/b]

New Artifacts were added to the game to synergize with the new mechanics changes:

Heavy Chopper: Add 3 extra CP whenever you resolve your Combo and Breaker effects
Mimiko’s Phaseshifter: Teleport whenever you Dash
Battle Mace: Apply an extra Combo point per hit whenever you are below 8 Health
Combat Staff: Your melee abilities apply an extra Combo point per hit
Feathered hat: Your ranged abilities apply an extra Combo point per hit
Grenade Launcher: Draw 1 card whenever you play a card but lose 4 Health
Paragon of Focus: Whenever you destroy an enemy with an ability, return it to your hand and change its cost to 0 until played

[b]UPDATED ARTIFACTS:[/b]

These Artifacts were changed:

Lost Medallion: Gain 2 Power whenever your team loses a Heart
Maleficent Crown: Apply 1 Vulnerable to all enemies whenever you lose a Hero in battle
Might of the Forest: Your abilities deal 1 extra damage for every 4 CP on the target
Nature’s Might: Deal damage equal to 50% of your Shield whenever an enemy hits you
Ornate Quiver: Gain 1 Power whenever you destroy an enemy with a ranged Ability
Twisted Staff: Restore 2 Health whenever you hit an enemy affected by Vulnerable
Apprentice Robes: Decrease the Burn, Bleed, Hex and Poison you receive by 1
Brass knuckles: Half of the Combo points remain on the target after you play a Breaker card
Dawnbreaker: Gain 1 Power and 1 Vulnerable at the start of each turn
Priest Battleguard: Gain 4 Immune whenever your team loses a Heart
Stormcast Pendant: Your Ultimate cost is reduced by 50%. Lose 4 Health whenever you add it to your hand

[b]NEW BATTLE FEATURES HIGHLIGHTS:[/b]

The combat mechanics received a ton of new upgrades and tweaks over the past weeks. Here are some of the main changes highlights:
CP (Combo Points): Combos are a new mechanic that’s been added to this patch. Everytime a Hero hits an enemy, you will apply a CP. This means that Multistrike cards are the most efficient way to apply CP. CP is used as “fuel” to trigger explosive and exciting new effects. For that reason, a lot of Abilities have been modified  to reflect this change. Please check out the in-game Collection to see how cards have been affected.
“Combo Scaling” Abilities: Some Abilities can now use the CP on the target to increase their effectiveness. Watch out for the new “Combo” keyword
“Combo Breaker” Abilities: Some Abilities can now destroy all current CP on the target to increase their effectiveness. Watch out for the new “Breaker” keyword
Action Points (AP): Action points are no longer shared by the entire team. Instead, Heroes receive their own AP to play Abilities. Heroes receive 3 new AP at the start of each turn.
AP rollover: Unused AP can now be stored for the next turns, to a max of 5AP total. Each Hero now has access to 5 AP slots maximum, visible on their portrait.
Fury meter cap raised to 30
“Recycle” mechanic. You can now Recycle any card in your hand by dragging it onto the Fury meter at the bottom right corner of the screen. Doing so will immediately Discard the card, but you will lose Fury equal to the card’s cost, as a drawback. This will allow you to unclog your hand whenever you feel the need.



[b]NEW EXPLORATION FEATURES HIGHLIGHTS:[/b]

Exploration has received the most changes, here are some highlights:

Hearts: Your team now starts with 5 Hearts (in Normal mode). Losing a Hero in Battle will destroy a Heart. You can lose Hearts from the map as well as in Battles. Losing all Hearts will terminate your run. Hearts can not be regained. To compensate for the change, Heroes have their Health reduced baseline.
New Corruption mechanic: Stepping on a Corrupted tile will damage your entire team for 10 Health.
Day/Night cycle changes: Used nodes will be turned into Battles whenever you reach Night time. Battle tiles will be turned into Loot caches, Oracles or Campsites.
Campsites changes: Campsites can now only heal your team but have multiple options. They no longer allow you to Upgrade a card
Oracles tiles (new): Oracles are a new node type and will allow you to Upgrade abilities, with multiple choice options.
Loot Caches: Loot caches will now grant you 3 random ability cards (1x per Hero) as well as a Consumable
Acts and Corruption meter: Corruption cap has been lowered to 10, from 40, and the game has been split in 4 acts. A new act is reached upon defeating a Shard and will reset the Corruption meter to 0/10.
Cataclysm: Cataclysm will trigger whenever you reach 10/10 Corruption on the meter. Every step you take in Cataclysm will corrupt all tiles adjacent to the Shard and will keep doing so until the map is entirely covered.
Bonus Card Upgrades are now given as a reward for defeating a Super Elite earlier than 10/10 Corruption on the meter. 1x Card upgrade will be given per 1 Corruption left on the meter upon defeating the Shard battle.
Deck Building: Heroes start with 2 copies of 4 starter abilities instead of 3 abilities. Increasing the minimum deck size to 8. Unlock the Ult+ by reaching a full deck size at 12 cards.


[b]OPTIMIZATION UPDATES:[/b]

We’ve managed to introduce some massive improvements in the code and added some resolution and windowed modes so the game will perform better on a wider variety of machines. A lot more optimization is coming, especially to the GPU and load on the graphics card. We hope you’ll feel a significant difference already. 
Added support for Fullscreen, Maximized Windowed, Fullscreen Windowed, and Windowed modes.
Added support for many resolutions in the 16:9, 16:10, and Ultrawide aspect ratios.


As always, thank you for your continued support! Have fun and please report any bugs you would find in-game. You can join the discussion on our Discord server at discord.gg/Arcanium
